preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range 1 to n.
The number of ants m is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n and a != b and c != d for a, b, c, d in ants)
preconditions.description: Each ant's favorite pairs (a_i, b_i) and (c_i, d_i) are distinct pairs of vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout == 'YES' and len(output_lines) == m and all(line in ['1', '2'] for line in output_lines))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', it is followed by m lines, each containing either '1' or '2'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or all((line == '1' and is_connected(a, b, color)) or (line == '2' and is_connected(c, d, color)) for (a, b, c, d), line, color in zip(ants, output_lines, range(1, m+1)))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each ant can use one of its favorite pairs to walk between vertices using only edges of its assigned color.
